title: Patient Management
description: Patient Management documentation for Super Admin.
overview: This guide covers patient management workflows for Super Admin.

subtasks.title: Open the Patient Mgmt Menu
subtasks.purpose: Understand what the three sub-items do.

subtasks.title: Look Up a Patient (General)
subtasks.purpose: Find a patient by name or by practice/provider/caregiver.

steps.title: Filter Patient Search
steps.description: Filter by any combination of Name, Practice, Provider, Caregiver, Status.

steps.title: Search & Review Results
steps.description: Click Search; review the result grid.

subtasks.title: Look Up Patient by RPM Date
subtasks.purpose: Find RPM patients seen inside a given service window.

steps.title: Navigate to RPM Lookup
steps.description: Sidebar → Patient Mgmt → Lookup Patient (by RPM date).

steps.title: Search RPM Records
steps.description: Search; grid returns RPM-specific columns (vitals coverage, last reading date, service time).

subtasks.title: Look Up Patient by CCM Date
subtasks.purpose: Care Management is where operational follow-ups are queried. Follow Up Query returns patients whose upload cadence or vitals need caregiver attention.
